name: The Mural
description: A painting on the attic walls made by the first keep-alives that shows the beasties' history and is neutral ground.

timeline.summary: The first keep-alives paint the mural on the attic walls with paint Spindlewight stole for them.
timeline.quote: They painted it on the attic walls with their own hands

timeline.summary: Without Spindlewight the beasties split into the packs they have today and declare the mural neutral ground.
